production.note: US model years. First: Motor1's report (source: BMW) is titled '2023 BMW M2 Debuts With 453-HP I6' and says 'The automaker plans to launch the coupe in the US market in April of 2023'; WardsAuto (Greg Kable) refers to 'the '23 M2', 'Set for deliveries during first-quarter 2023' (wards-2023-m2). No BMW NA page for the 2023 launch was opened. Still on sale: BMW NA's 2026 release on the M2 with M xDrive speaks of 'The new 2027 BMW M2 with M xDrive ... expanding the breadth of the M2 model line-up' (bmw-us-2027-m2-xdrive-release), and on 2026-10-01 bmwusa.com listed the rear-wheel-drive manual M2 ('473 @ 6,250', '3,814 lbs') (bmwusa-m2-tech).

configuration.note: 'inline 6-cylinder in-line engine with M TwinPower Turbo technology'

fuel.note: Inferred from the release's description of the gasoline S58 inline-6.

drivetrain.note: 'rear-wheel-drive'. The M2 with M xDrive (all-wheel drive, automatic only, 3,988 lb) was added for model year 2027 as its own model (bmw-us-2027-m2-xdrive-release) and is not part of this record.

transmission.note: 'Type | 6-sp. manual | 8-sp. M Steptronic' (M Steptronic is a torque-converter automatic). At launch WardsAuto reports a '6-speed manual gearbox as standard in the North American market' and an 'optional 8-speed, automatic' (wards-2023-m2).

powerHp.note: 2025 rating, manual and automatic. Quote: "Max output (hp @ RPM) | 473 @ 6,250". Also: "Front and center of this fresh round of updates is the 20 hp added to its output: the high-revving inline 6-cylinder in-line engine with M TwinPower Turbo technology now tops out at 473 hp." The 2023 and 2024 cars were rated 453 hp: Motor1 'produces 453 horsepower' (motor1-2023-m2-debut), WardsAuto '453 hp at 6,250 rpm' (wards-2023-m2); no BMW NA page for those years was opened. The 473 hp rating covers model years 2025 to 2027 (bmwusa-m2-tech, bmw-us-2027-m2-xdrive-release), more than half of the run, so the reference year is 2025.

weightLb.note: 2025 M2 with the 6-speed manual. Quote: "Curb weight (lbs) | 3,814 | 3,867" (columns 'M2 6MT' and 'M2 8AT'). bmwusa.com gives the same 3,814 lb for the 2026 manual (bmwusa-m2-tech).
